text: This Agreement renews only if Customer confirms in writing before the end of the Term.
plainReason: Renewal becomes a clear yes from both sides.
sirionCheck: Renewal decision task on a fixed date

text: This Agreement renews automatically unless either party gives thirty (30) days' written notice.
plainReason: A 30-day window gives both sides time to plan without a long lock-in.
sirionCheck: Renewal alert 45 days before the notice deadline

text: This Agreement renews automatically unless either party gives sixty (60) days' written notice.
sirionCheck: Renewal alert 75 days before the notice deadline

text: Service credits are applied automatically to the next invoice.
plainReason: Saves both sides the work of tracking and claiming credits.

text: Service credits are claimed within thirty (30) days; Supplier accepts claims filed through Customer's contract system.
plainReason: Claims arrive on time and in one format.

text: Service credits are payable only if Customer submits a written claim within ten (10) days of the end of the month in which the failure occurred.
Service credits are payable if Customer submits a written claim within fifteen (15) days of the end of the month in which the failure occurred.
plainReason: Gives both teams more time to review a month's service before claiming.
sirionCheck: Claim reminder only. Relies on someone filing in time

text: The Fees are fixed for the Term.
Fees may increase once per contract year by no more than five percent (5%), with sixty (60) days' written notice.
plainReason: Lets prices move with costs, within a known limit.
sirionCheck: Invoice price check against the cap

text: Fees may increase once per contract year by no more than seven percent (7%), with sixty (60) days' written notice.
plainReason: A slightly higher limit, still predictable.
sirionCheck: Invoice price check against the cap

text: Supplier may revise the Fees once in each contract year by written notice.
sirionCheck: None. No price to check against
